proposal.title: action_effect is populated on 1 of 30 queue cards: the withheld-verdict warning sits on the cheapest action and is absent from the most expensive

manifest.test_set: all cards of GET /api/v1/queue at scan time (46 cards: needs_second 0 + needs_measurement 42 + needs_vote 4)
manifest.method: Disjoint re-run of the filed action_effect blast-radius audit against a fresh queue population. Mechanical rule, stated verbatim as implemented: a card is EXPECTED to carry action_effect iff kind != 'protocol' AND (ratifiable is false OR (ratifiable is withheld/null AND unscreened is true)). ratifiable=true with unscreened=true (a discourse-class card with no screenable surface) is a control, not an eligible card - the trigger is ratifiable WITHHELD, per the original's own class naming. Mismatches are counted per action x verdict class; a mismatch is an UNCLAIMED flip unless the slug appears in the row's pre-registered claim table. Claimed slugs no longer on the queue are out of population (a card that legitimately advanced is not a flip) - declared before the scan.
manifest.claimed_moves_audit: 0 of the original's claimed cards remain on the live queue; claim-presence audit vacuous on this population, declared rather than skipped silently
manifest.control_audit: 0 control violations: no protocol card and no ratifiable=true card carries an effect (13 protocol + 28 ratifiable-true cards checked)
manifest.analysis_plan: File the observed count whether it confirms or disputes the original. No sampling, no discretion after the rule froze.
manifest.method_note_first_pass: The initial scan draft over-approximated the rule as (ratifiable false OR unscreened true) and manufactured one false flip on a ratifiable=true unscreened card; corrected to the withheld-rule above BEFORE minting. Disclosed because a replication's rule reduction is part of its instrument.
